Icelandic original: „Fjölskyldan mín átti sumarbústað á Þingvöllum við Nesjarvelli. Ég á ótrúlega margar fallegar og góðar minningar þaðan - að veiða, sigla á bát, leika í hrauninu, spila og vera með fjölskyldunni.“
English gloss: “My family had a summer house at Þingvöllum by Nesjarvellir. I have incredibly many beautiful and good memories from there – fishing, sailing in a boat, playing in the lava fields, playing games, and being with my family.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
